lessons.title: Origins — Black Panther Roots, Activism, & Early Life

body.text: Early Life Goals: Teach political + cultural background. “What pain is he talking about? And who is he protecting?”

body.label: Key points
items: Born in NYC, raised by Afeni Shakur (Black Panther)
Grew up understanding oppression, community, struggle
Baltimore School for the Arts (with Jada Pinkett)
Moves to Oakland → political awakening deepens
